data.name: Patron Spells
data.description: [NOT IMPLEMENTED] An herb witch must choose a patron with a theme compatible with the needs of the natural world, selected from the following list: ancestors, animals, death, elements, healing, plague, strength, time, water, winter, wisdom, or woodlands. This alters the witch's patron spells.
